source_coordinates: Python character offsets in NFC parser text, not PDF byte offsets

chunking.unpunctuated_fallback: BOUNDED_SOURCE_SPLIT; not proof of semantic completeness

citation_extraction.input: Readable source text before chunk-local interpretation
citation_extraction.output: C03 plus exact occurrence intersections in the active chunks
citation_extraction.unreadable_pages: BARRIER; never join legal-name/number fragments across them
citation_extraction.missing_source: Never reconstruct missing characters or catalog identities

retrieval_context.parent: Contiguous chunks sharing the same article path; preserve annex ancestry
retrieval_context.cross_reference: Explicit internal contract target with unique structural identity
retrieval_context.legal_conclusion: None; context selection does not prove a criterion

reasoning.criterion_source: Pinned knowledge criterion and decision rules
reasoning.candidate_fact_verification: None; source aliases do not verify proposed fact values
reasoning.human_review: PENDING until an attributable review decision

reference_data.old_seed_and_reports: Remain pinned to their original source/extraction/run
reference_data.new_chunks: Rebuild C06 and downstream snapshots; do not relabel old answers
reference_data.trial_workbook: Inspection only, not seedable and not legal gold
reference_data.evaluation: DEV first; VALIDATION after method freeze; TEST is not selected by tooling
reference_data.pdf_edits: Only for an actual source defect with new checksum and provenance
